data.title: Sanvitalia
data.extract:
Sanvitalia ), the creeping zinnias, is a genus of flowering plants belonging to the family Asteraceae. They are native mostly to Mexico, with a few species in Central America, South America, and the Southwestern United States.SpeciesSanvitalia abertii A.Gray - Abert's creeping zinnia - Mexico (Sonora), southwestern United States

Sanvitalia fruticosa Hemsl. - Puebla, Oaxaca, Guanajuato
Sanvitalia ocymoides DC. -- yellow creeping zinnia - Tamaulipas, Nuevo León, Texas

Sanvitalia ), the creeping zinnias, is a genus of flowering plants belonging to the family Asteraceae. They are native mostly to Mexico, with a few species in Central America, South America, and the Southwestern United States.

Species
  • Sanvitalia abertii A.Gray - Abert's creeping zinnia - Mexico (Sonora), southwestern United States
  • Sanvitalia angustifolia Engelm. ex A.Gray - Coahuila, Chihuahua, Guanajuato, Nuevo León, San Luis Potosí; introduced in western Texas
  • Sanvitalia fruticosa Hemsl. - Puebla, Oaxaca, Guanajuato
  • Sanvitalia ocymoides DC. -- yellow creeping zinnia - Tamaulipas, Nuevo León, Texas
  • Sanvitalia procumbens Lam. - Mexican creeping zinnia - Mexico from Chihuahua to Chiapas; Central America; naturalized in scattered locations in Europe, East Asia, South America, and United States
  • Sanvitalia versicolor Griseb. - Bolivia, Paraguay, Argentina
